instruction:
Using the official Transport for London StopPoint response for HUBKGX, report its StopPoint ID, common name, latitude, longitude, every top-level transport mode, Zone value, and every Tube line identifier listed in the Tube line-mode group.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested interchange identity, location, mode, zone, and Tube-line fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use the supplied official TfL API response.
- Read Zone from the additionalProperties entry whose key is Zone.
- Read Tube line identifiers only from the lineModeGroups entry whose modeName is tube.
- Do not include bus or national-rail line identifiers in the Tube list, and preserve identifiers exactly.
